curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can he protect the teller he loves while two robberies unfold around them?
curatedMovie.description: Caught inside a bank targeted by two separate robbery crews at the exact same moment, an ordinary man must navigate the crossfire to protect the teller he is secretly in love with.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast, funny, and suspenseful; an engaging comic crime caper packed into a brisk 87-minute date-night watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Rob Minkoff balances comic chaos with genuine crime-mystery suspense, turning an overlapping double heist into a fast, witty, and contained crowd-pleaser.
